greetings.text: Hullo! You haven't any food on you, by any chance? I'm half-starved.
I say, what a lovely morning. Are you coming to the party? What party? Oh, never mind.
There you are! We've been having a rare time of it.
Hullo! Come and sit down, we're having a lovely evening. Have you got any beer?

farewells.text: Right, I'd better see if Frodo's finished fussing.

smalltalk.text: I'm a Took, you know. Tooks have adventures. Or so everyone says.
A song? Of course. Which one? The one about the Man in the Moon, I should think.
Is it dinner time? It always seems to be a bit before dinner time.
Frodo's keeping something from us. Not that I'm asking. I'm very good at not asking.

black_rider_in_hobbiton.text: A black rider in the lane? Honestly, it sent a shiver through me. I wasn't going to say, but I'm not sorry you asked.

maggot_dogs_and_rider.text: Farmer Maggot's dogs! He gave us a fright, but it turned out he was kindness itself. Mushrooms, mind you. A whole basket.
